scope: Targeted review of major interactive video world memory, control, geometry and evaluation papers; not a claim of exhaustive bibliometric coverage. Abstracts and selected methods/results/limitations were checked; not every paper read line by line.
ranking_caveat: Different datasets, controllers, camera trajectories, resolutions, speeds and evaluation definitions prevent a universal model ranking. Paper-reported numbers are not reproduced by us.
recommended_order: Verify control on fixed round trips with realized camera motion.
Compare stock cache, budget-feasible retained history, and relevant retrieval at matched settings.
Prioritize DeCoPrune as a direct v2-compatible research reference; do not inherit its changed denoising schedule silently.
Test WorldKV-style native KV retrieval and correct temporal RoPE handling as separate ablations.
If retrieval cannot preserve geometry, use visibility-aware local geometric memory and train a conditioning adapter.
Use exposure-bias fine-tuning for recurring drift; separately model dynamic event state.

papers.name: GEN3C
papers.mechanism: Render a persistent depth-derived point cache into requested camera views.
papers.applicability: Requires a generator trained for geometric conditioning; foundational reference.

papers.name: WorldMem
papers.mechanism: Store frames with poses and timestamps and use state-aware memory attention.
papers.applicability: Useful retrieval and dynamic-time design; not a tested plug-in for our v2 checkpoint.

papers.name: Context as Memory
papers.mechanism: Retrieve raw history by camera field-of-view overlap.
papers.applicability: Useful retrieval baseline; its trained conditioning path must not be assumed present in LingBot.

papers.name: VMem
papers.mechanism: Index past views by the surfels they observed.
papers.applicability: Useful visibility-aware retrieval rather than simply nearest pose.

papers.name: Self Forcing
papers.mechanism: Train autoregressive generation on its own outputs.
papers.applicability: Training strategy; not an inference flag or proof of persistent geometry.

papers.name: History-Guided Video Diffusion
papers.mechanism: Guide diffusion with variable and differently noised history.
papers.applicability: Requires a compatible trained diffusion-forcing backbone.

papers.name: Stable Video Infinity
papers.mechanism: Recycle generated errors into fine-tuning histories.
papers.applicability: Relevant adapter-training inspiration; long videos alone do not prove revisits.

papers.name: WorldPack: Dynamic Frame Compression for Long-context Video World Modeling
papers.mechanism: Compress trajectory history and retrieve relevant memory.
papers.applicability: Context efficiency research; domain and checkpoint transfer need evaluation.

papers.name: Infinite-World
papers.mechanism: Hierarchical pose-free compression, uncertainty-aware action labels, revisit-dense fine-tuning.
papers.applicability: Relevant when camera estimates are noisy; the paper reports a compact 30-minute revisit training set.

papers.name: AnchorWeave
papers.mechanism: Retrieve clean local geometric memories and reconcile multiple anchors.
papers.applicability: Avoid fusing noisy generated geometry into a single supposedly authoritative map.

papers.name: PERSIST: Beyond Pixel Histories
papers.mechanism: Maintain and evolve a persistent latent 3D world representation.
papers.applicability: Strong architectural direction; evaluation is in Luanti voxel worlds, not a direct LingBot patch.

papers.name: Lyra 2.0
papers.mechanism: Use geometry to route historical views and train on self-augmented degraded histories.
papers.applicability: Code, checkpoints and training recipe checked in nv-tlabs/lyra; useful geometry reference baseline.

papers.name: WorldKV
papers.mechanism: Archive evicted native KV, retrieve relevant chunks and compress redundant tokens.
papers.applicability: Published main backbones are LingBot-World-Fast v1 and Matrix-Game 2.0; v2 transfer remains an experiment.

papers.name: GIM-World: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory
papers.mechanism: Compress history into fixed memory tokens with a geometry teacher during training.
papers.applicability: Lightweight memory-module direction; requires learned integration.

papers.name: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models (LSM-World; earlier Mirage title)
papers.mechanism: Lift VAE features into a persistent 3D cache and query through latent warping.
papers.applicability: Official Microsoft code now available. Wan2.2 TI2V5B with VACE conditioning and LoRA; inference expects separately trained adapter checkpoints. Not a zero-shot LingBot plugin.

papers.name: Mem-World
papers.mechanism: Use time-indexed 4D wrist-view surfels to retrieve history for future actions.
papers.applicability: Robot manipulation evidence; not proof of arbitrary open-world performance.

papers.name: WorldDirector
papers.mechanism: Separate semantic motion planning and 3D entity trajectories from visual generation.
papers.applicability: Relevant to off-screen evolution; an object-state store must actually condition generation.

papers.name: LingBot-World2: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.mechanism: Existing open action-conditioned world model used by this project.
papers.applicability: Public local causal-fast checkpoint is distinct from the hosted PlayWorld service.

papers.name: AlayaWorld full technical report
papers.mechanism: Combine sink, compressed history, geometry memory and recent context with corrupted-history training.
papers.applicability: Open system reference; its paper benchmark and released variant must be identified precisely.

papers.name: Wonder
papers.mechanism: Use dense coordinate-field camera conditioning, sparse retrieval and corrected distillation.
papers.applicability: Control fidelity and memory must be evaluated together.

papers.name: WorldTrace: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
papers.mechanism: Assign distinct in-range virtual positions and merge keys in canonical coordinates.
papers.applicability: Read v2 revised 11 Nov 2026; main Matrix-Game-2 evaluation plus earlier LingBot appendix, not demonstrated v2 transfer.

papers.name: Matrix-Game 3.5
papers.mechanism: Use patch memory, projective camera conditioning and separate static/dynamic representation.
papers.applicability: Newer than the Matrix-Game 3.0 row on PlayWorld; not evidence of a newer PlayWorld score.

papers.name: DeCoPrune
papers.mechanism: Keep historical KV tokens with large intermediate-to-final denoising discrepancies.
papers.applicability: Direct LingBot World v2 evidence; released config names 14B causal-fast. Schedule differs from our stock settings.

papers.name: Learning to Retrieve
papers.mechanism: Learn pose-conditioned internal recurrent retrieval with revisibility supervision.
papers.applicability: Trains memory layers; evaluated Wan and SANA variants, not a zero-shot LingBot modification.

papers.name: World-T3
papers.mechanism: Update a pose-keyed parametric memory with recursive least squares and distill a few-step generator.
papers.applicability: Strong memory/speed result on its own revisit protocol; requires trained memory and distillation, not a drop-in knob.

papers.name: Mallea
papers.mechanism: Let executable object rules advance state and let a generative renderer use persistent appearance.
papers.applicability: Alternative hybrid simulator formulation; distinguish it from extending a frozen video model.

papers.name: WorldPager
papers.mechanism: Tier archived KV across GPU, DRAM and NVMe with pose-driven prefetch and position handling.
papers.applicability: A memory-capacity result; long runtime is not proof of perfect world coherence. Matrix-Game-2 system.

papers.name: Hy-Nomas
papers.mechanism: Use structured persistent descriptions, temporally local actions and training on generated histories.
papers.applicability: Official code, weights and LoRA workflow available; author human comparisons are not PlayWorld rankings.

papers.name: L3G-World
papers.mechanism: Update latent 3D Gaussians and render directly into diffusion latent space.
papers.applicability: Static scene focus. Official repository release checklist remains pending for inference code and checkpoints at review time.

papers.name: AgiWorld
papers.mechanism: Share spatial memory between a world-building agent and the generator; retrieve visible surfaces and prefer reliable earlier geometry.
papers.applicability: Submitted 2 Nov 2026; official project says Code soon. Reported benchmark advantage is not a PlayWorld score.

papers.name: PlayWorld
papers.mechanism: Evaluate player-driven geometry, interaction and visible/hidden evolution.
papers.applicability: Published table: Genie 3 2.12, LingBot-World2 1.82, Matrix-Game-3.0 1.14. Our Claude score is not directly comparable.

papers.name: MemoBench
papers.mechanism: Test processes that continue while their target leaves view.
papers.applicability: Separate successful camera departure/return from semantic dynamic memory.

papers.name: WorldMemBench
papers.mechanism: Test static and dynamic memory across repeated camera departures and returns.
papers.applicability: Table 2: HY-WorldPlay leads static metrics; LingBot-World v1 leads dynamic memory. Different capabilities have different leaders.

papers.name: WorldProbe
papers.mechanism: Use closed-loop agent exploration and realized reconstructed poses over long rollouts.
papers.applicability: Useful diagnostics up to 180 seconds; local visual stability does not establish long-range memory.

papers.name: Robust Dreamer: Deviation-Aware Latent Gaussian Memory
papers.mechanism: Store inherited diffusion latents on Gaussian primitives and train against rollout-like memory corruption.
papers.applicability: Uses LoRA, so compatible in principle with no-from-scratch constraint. Authors report substantial multi-GPU training; project code still Coming Soon. Not reproduced or integrated.
